EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Provider Detail Schema and Contract Definition
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define and standardize the provider detail response schema including NPI, full name, specialty taxonomy, license status, practice address, phone, enumeration date, and external reference links (e.g., state medical boards). Ensure compatibility with evaluate_care_facade and LLM tool responses.

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: NPI Provider Detail Retrieval and Normalization Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement core service logic to call the CMS NPI Registry API, extract provider credentials, normalize specialty and license fields, enrich with known state board links, and gracefully handle null, missing, or inconsistent data.

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Provider Detail
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade, ensuring the service is callable via tool routing and returns structured data aligned with evaluation workflows and downstream quality signals.

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Provider Detail API and Tool Exposure
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Expose provider detail lookup via FastAPI and register it with the tool_router for LLM tool-use, including input validation, error handling, and structured JSON output compliant with the defined schema.

EVAL-F-002-S5.title: Provider Detail Unit and End-to-End Integration Tests
EVAL-F-002-S5.description: Implement unit tests for NPI response parsing, normalization, and link enrichment, plus integration tests validating full flow from API → tool_router → facade → service, including edge cases (missing fields, invalid NPI, empty results).
EVAL-F-002-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing provider detail test file found; must be implemented in backend/tests
